'''Alex Chui Tsz Fung''' ({{lang-zh|t=徐子豐|cy=Cheui Ji2 Fung1}}; born 2008), is a Hong Kong-born British student who is currently the most decorated [[International Mathematical Olympiad]] (IMO) contestant since July 2026, with five gold medals and two silver medals. He represented [[Hong Kong]] and later represented the [[United Kingdom]].<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |title=Alex Chui |url=https://www.imo-official.org/results/contestant/30257/ |access-date=27 August 2026 |website=[[International Mathematical Olympiad]]}}</ref> He is the first and only competitor to ever win seven medals consecutively at the IMO.<ref name=":5">{{Cite web |last=Whipple |first=Tom |date=26 July 2026 |title=Perfect score makes Briton most successful ever in maths olympiad |url=https://www.thetimes.com/uk/education/article/alex-chui-international-mathematical-olympiad-wsscznkj6 |access-date=27 August 2026 |website=[[The Times]] |language=en-GB}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==

Chui was born to a family of four. He has an older brother. At age 7, Chui took an IQ test scoring 144.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=24 September 2019 |title=【因材施教】11歲資優生IQ測試平均表現達144　入選國際奧數港隊成唯一小學成員 |url=https://topick.hket.com/article/2458781/%E3%80%90%E5%9B%A0%E6%9D%90%E6%96%BD%E6%95%99%E3%80%9111%E6%AD%B2%E8%B3%87%E5%84%AA%E7%94%9FIQ%E6%B8%AC%E8%A9%A6%E5%B9%B3%E5%9D%87%E8%A1%A8%E7%8F%BE%E9%81%94144%E3%80%80%E5%85%A5%E9%81%B8%E5%9C%8B%E9%9A%9B%E5%A5%A7%E6%95%B8%E6%B8%AF%E9%9A%8A%E6%88%90%E5%94%AF%E4%B8%80%E5%B0%8F%E5%AD%B8%E6%88%90%E5%93%A1 |website=[[Hong Kong Economic Times]]}}</ref> Around this age he attended the gifted student program at the [[Chinese University of Hong Kong]] for the first time and skipped some of the more advanced math courses.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=鄺曉斌 |date=25 September 2019 |title=資優小六生擊敗高中尖子 躋身奧數港隊 父母無意跳級：循序漸進 |url=https://www.hk01.com/%E7%A4%BE%E6%9C%83%E6%96%B0%E8%81%9E/378349/%E8%B3%87%E5%84%AA%E5%B0%8F%E5%85%AD%E7%94%9F%E6%93%8A%E6%95%97%E9%AB%98%E4%B8%AD%E5%B0%96%E5%AD%90-%E8%BA%8B%E8%BA%AB%E5%A5%A7%E6%95%B8%E6%B8%AF%E9%9A%8A-%E7%88%B6%E6%AF%8D%E7%84%A1%E6%84%8F%E8%B7%B3%E7%B4%9A-%E5%BE%AA%E5%BA%8F%E6%BC%B8%E9%80%B2 |access-date=27 August 2026 |website=[[HK01]] |language=zh-HK}}</ref>

Chui attended Ma Tau Chung Government Primary School.<ref name=":1" /> In 2017, he passed the assessment of the [[Hong Kong Academy for Gifted Education]] to become a student there. He participated in the selection process for the Hong Kong Mathematics Olympiad and became a reserve member of the team while being the only primary school student.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |date=24 May 2023 |title=資優數學男童 愛鑽研解難保持爭勝心 |url=https://paper.hket.com/article/3532670/%E8%B3%87%E5%84%AA%E6%95%B8%E5%AD%B8%E7%94%B7%E7%AB%A5%20%E6%84%9B%E9%91%BD%E7%A0%94%E8%A7%A3%E9%9B%A3%E4%BF%9D%E6%8C%81%E7%88%AD%E5%8B%9D%E5%BF%83 |website=[[Hong Kong Economic Times]]}}</ref>

Despite Chui's aptitude, he went through a regular schooling process and did not skip any grades. After primary school, he attended [[Diocesan Boys' School]].<ref name=":2" />

During the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], Chui represented Hong Kong at the IMO via online competition. In 2020, Chui participated in his first IMO competition winning a silver medal. This was followed by a gold medal in 2021.<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":2" /><ref name=":4">{{Cite web |last=Minh |first=Nga |date=22 July 2026 |title=Teen boy secures historic 5th International Math Olympiad gold with perfect score |url=https://e.vnexpress.net/news/tech/challenge-hub/which-country-is-home-to-the-most-decorated-imo-participant-of-all-time-5104690.html |website=[[VnExpress]]}}</ref>

In 2022 Chui moved to the United Kingdom to attend [[Tonbridge School]].<ref name=":5" /><ref name=":4" /> Up until July 2026, while representing the United Kingdom at the IMO, Chui obtained three golds medals and one silver medals with scores consistently ranging between 28 and 35 points. In July 2026, in his seventh and final appearance at the IMO in [[Shanghai]], China, Chui obtained a gold medal with a perfect score of 42. With this Chui become the most decorated IMO contestant of all time and the second to obtain five gold medals after [[Zhuo Qun Song]].<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":4" />

Chui will be studying mathematics at [[University of Cambridge]] in 2027.<ref name=":5" />
